# UKAS

> UKAS is the United Kingdom's national accreditation body that provides conformity assessment and quality assurance across testing laboratories, medical facilities, inspection bodies, and certification services.

UKAS accredits organizations across diverse sectors including medical laboratories, testing facilities, calibration services, and inspection bodies to ISO standards. The site guides organizations through the accreditation process while maintaining a searchable directory of accredited providers.

## Key Topics

- UKAS Accreditation
- Conformity Assessment
- Quality Assurance
- ISO Standards
- ISO 15189:2022
- ISO/IEC 17020
- Medical Laboratories
- Testing Laboratories
- Calibration Laboratories
- Inspection Bodies
- Certification Bodies
- Accreditation Process
- Assessment Process
- Application Requirements
- Government & Public Sector

- [Accreditation vs Certification: What's the difference?](https://www.ukas.com/accreditation/about/accreditation-vs-certification): Explanation of differences between accreditation and certification in quality assurance
